description: This file defines the VueControllerException class, which extends the base Exception class. It provides a custom exception for handling specific errors related to Vue controller operations within the OrangeHRM project.

classes.name: VueControllerException
classes.description: A custom exception class for Vue controller errors, extends the base PHP Exception class.

methods.name: alreadyHandled
methods.description: Static method that returns a new instance of VueControllerException with a predefined error message indicating the request has already been handled.
